0 1000 1000 (also known as 1001 or Russian Schnapsen) is a trick-taking card game using a playing card pack of only 24 cards. Each player bids the number of points to take, then the highest bidder takes spare cards and then starts the first trick. Points can be earned by taking tricks or declaring melds in hand. Declaring a meld changes the trump suit as well. Number of players: 2 - 4 Game duration: 29 mn Complexity: 2 / 5 Play 1000 and 1414 other games online. No download necessary - play directly from your web browser. With your friends and thousands of players from the whole world. Free. [Rating: 5.5/10] Disappointed in the lack of decision-making and mostly uninteresting card play, (compared to a point-trick taker like Briscola where there's no requirement to follow suit).   The bidding was the only really thought-provoking aspect, as it's very tempting to gain the 3 face down cards. Relatively few marriages were declared, which means playing without a trump suit. Fine for what it is, but I'd much rather learn and play other card games.

[Rating: 6/10] This is a game that gets in its own way. It's the scoring. The game is a relatively straightforward point-trick-taking game in the Marriage family with a novel trump-setting mechanism--you need to win a trick and then declare a marriage; the suit of the marriage becomes trump, so trump could potentially change during the course of one hand. It's a bit chaotic, perhaps, but it's interesting and can be fun to explore. Where things fall down is in the negative scoring.
